name: TrustDemoDT06
title: TD.DT.06 Does the receiver follow the VHL?
description: For one scanned VHL, decide whether the receiver requests the manifest or treats the family's records like paper. Requirements: STT-VER-001, STT-VER-008, STT-VHL-009, STT-VHL-005. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When result is failed: next = treat-as-paper. STT-VER-008: the typed result names the step and reason, for example a DSC missing from the cached trust list (STT-VER-006). The clinician records why it was not verified.

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When result is verified and vhlExpired is true: next = treat-as-paper. STT-VHL-009: an expired link is not followed.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When result is verified and vhlExpired is false: next = fetch. Request the manifest by ITI-YY5 with an HTTP Message Signature (STT-VHL-005); the portal then applies TD.DT.05. Provenance TrustDemoJ41Received.
